http://www.coreelements.uk.com

Core Elements Training was founded by Dawn Morse who has a Masters Degree in Sports and Health Sciences, is a qualified teacher and Sports Therapist. 
Dawn has extensive teaching experience with teaching roles include being the programme leader for the University of Bath Sports Therapy Degree and a Associate Lecturer for the Open University in Sports Science. 

Dawn has had many articles published and has assisted with several research projects. 
Dawn and other qualified tutors at Core Elements Training offer a range of independently accredited Sports Massage and Sports Therapy qualifications and CPD  short courses including: Dry Cupping, Dy Needling, Electrotherapy, Joint Mobilisations and more.  
All courses are available as face to face delivery at the #Swindon Training Centre and wider venues in the #U.K. and abroad.
A selection of courses are also available via Live Online delivery  or fully Online.
To find out more please visit our website.
